result.summary: Found 1 issue: a section heading renders a raw localization key instead of user-facing text.

issues.description: The section heading beneath the 'Fastest near you' carousel displays the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a readable title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the translation for this key before rendering (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing keys never surface raw strings in the UI.
